trajectory.title: Experience
paragraphs: With roots dating back to the late 19th century, Codeex's history is marked by a family tradition linked to construction. Founding partner Carmelo Corallo developed landmark works in Mendoza and San Juan, participating in projects of great architectural value that are still part of the region's heritage today.

That legacy of craft, commitment, and excellence was passed down from generation to generation, giving rise to Codeex S.R.L., a company that keeps the art of building well alive while adapting it to today's challenges.
Today, Codeex integrates design, management, and execution under a turnkey system, guaranteeing control, quality, and efficiency at every stage of the project.
